crossRefs.note: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still.
I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your…
Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one…
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked…
whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy…
I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but…
“If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;
He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
“Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

translations.web: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
translations.bsb: On my bed at night I sought the one I love; I sought him, but did not find him.
